summary: Iteration 2 backend testing for PitchPro (Fees, Staff usage, Admin charts, CORS regression). Wrote /app/backend/tests/test_iteration2.py with 29 pytest cases — ALL 29 PASSED. Covered: GET /api/admin/charts (shape + 14-day timeseries + role-forbidden for user/coach + 401 unauth), GET /api/staff/lane-usage & /api/staff/coach-usage (admin+coach allowed, user 403, correct slot shape + available_today flag), GET /api/fees/me (3 seeded fees visible to user@cricketacademy.com), GET /api/fees (admin only), full POST->GET->mark-paid->DELETE flow with notification propagation, 403 for user/coach POST, 404 for bad user/fee, 401 unauth, and regression smoke (lanes/coaches/games listing, announcements, bookings/me, admin/stats, progress/me, notifications/me, auth/me). Also ran the iteration-1 suite (/app/backend/tests/backend_test.py): 30 passed, 1 skipped, 2 FAILED — both due to test-state pollution (brute-force login_attempts accumulated across iterations; session slot already booked from prior run). These are pre-existing test-isolation issues, NOT iteration-2 regressions.

minor.issue: Backend middleware now correctly uses allow_origins=origins with allow_credentials=true (iteration-1 finding fixed). BUT the Kubernetes/Cloudflare ingress intercepts OPTIONS preflight and responds with access-control-allow-origin: '*' and no allow-credentials — so browser preflight for credentialed requests relies on the actual request pass-through, which does include allow-credentials:true. Cookies work in practice but the edge config is inconsistent with the backend config. Infra-level — not fixable in backend code.

UNCHANGED from iteration-1: filters by user['coach_id'] which is never set on coach seed user — coach always sees empty list. Not exercised by iteration-2 new endpoints but still a latent bug for the new Academy-login dashboard if it uses this route.
Returns ok=true even when fee_id does not exist (no 404). Inconsistent with mark-paid which returns 404.
No notification sent to user when fee is marked paid — only fee_added notification exists. Parent dashboard will not get real-time confirmation.
FeeIn has no validation that amount > 0 or due_date is valid YYYY-MM-DD (accepts any string). Also no kid_name cross-check against user.kids.
Loads full bookings/sessions collections (to_list(5000)) into memory each call — will degrade with scale. Consider date-range $match + aggregation pipeline.
Both load all lanes/coaches then scan bookings/sessions in Python — O(lanes*bookings). Fine at MVP scale but should use aggregation with $lookup later.

test_brute_force_lockout now fails with 6x 401 instead of 429. Likely cause: login_attempts collection has accumulated data across iterations AND/OR identifier=ip:email uses ingress IP which may differ. Preexisting test-isolation issue, not a new bug — basic behavior still passes for a clean identifier.

test_coach_availability_and_create_session now fails with 409 because a session for the same coach+date+hour already exists (leftover from previous iteration runs). Test needs randomized session_date per run.

action_items: (carryover) Fix coach-user → coach_id linkage so GET /api/sessions returns data for coach role (used by new Academy login dashboard).
DELETE /api/fees/{id} should return 404 when fee doesn't exist (currently silent 200).
Add payment notification on PUT /api/fees/{id}/mark-paid so parent dashboard gets the 'paid' confirmation event.
Tighten FeeIn validation: amount > 0, due_date ISO-8601 format.
Make iteration-1 brute-force & session-conflict tests self-isolating (clear login_attempts; randomize session_date) — they are flaky on re-run.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py now 1286 lines — growing past the 700-line threshold. Split into routers/fees.py, routers/staff.py, routers/admin.py, routers/auth.py with services/seed.py.
Admin charts endpoint uses manual O(N) python loops on full collections; MongoDB aggregation pipelines would be cleaner and scale better.
seed_demo_activity is idempotent only via 'fees count > 0' — if fees are deleted by admin, it will never re-seed; fine for MVP but worth documenting.
Mock notifications are inserted synchronously inside request handlers — on a slow mongo this adds latency per booking/fee/session. Consider background tasks.
FastAPI @app.on_event is still used (iteration-1 finding unresolved); migrate to lifespan.
All new Fee/Staff endpoints correctly strip _id via doc_serialize/find projection — good.

success_rate.backend: 100% on iteration-2 suite (29/29). 30/33 on iteration-1 suite (2 flaky test-state failures, 1 skipped)

seed_data_creation: seed_demo_activity seeds 12 past-day bookings, ~10 past-day sessions (respecting coach available_days), 3 fees for user@cricketacademy.com (1 paid, 2 pending), and 3 weekly progress reports for Aarav Sharma. Verified via /api/fees/me and /api/admin/charts timeseries.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration-2 tests at /app/backend/tests/test_iteration2.py are reusable as regression. The iteration-1 suite has 2 flaky tests due to shared login_attempts and sessions state — when re-running on a fresh DB they pass. Before rerunning iteration-1, clear db.login_attempts and use a future random date for the session conflict test. New endpoints all respect role-based access correctly. Main outstanding real bugs: coach_id not set on coach user (iteration-1 carryover) & DELETE /api/fees/{id} silently succeeds on missing id.
rca of the issue: No failures on new iteration-2 endpoints. For DELETE /api/fees/{id} silent success: server.py:846-850 does db.fees.delete_one without checking deleted_count → always returns {ok:true}. Fix: raise HTTPException(404) if res.deleted_count == 0. For brute-force test flake: login_attempts collection persists across runs and prior test runs already populated entries that either put identifier in locked_until state or (if lockout expired) reset attempts to 0 — causing 5 fresh 401s in the new run without hitting 429. Fix: clear_attempts in a pytest fixture setup, or use a unique email per test.
